Register
Getting Started:
New Users
:
1)
Create
a conference account.
2) Follow the registration instructions below.
Existing Users
:
1) Log in to your existing account (upper right-hand corner of this page).
Note: Your TAICEP conference account is separate from your TAICEP membership account, so your TAICEP website login credentials will not work on the conference website.
2) Follow the registration instructions below.
Register:
1) At the bottom of this page, first select the number of attendees you are registering. Choose "1" if you are registering only yourself.
2) When registering each individual, fill in the required information and choose the ticket options from the list on the right.
3) During checkout, you will have the option to pay either by credit card or check.
If you experience difficulty submitting payment through PayPal's 'Pay with Credit/Debit Card' option, you can often resolve the issue by contacting your credit card company or bank, which may have flagged the transaction as suspicious. You can also try using a different internet browser and/or clearing your browser cache and cookies.
If you have questions about the registration process, please email
answers@taicep.org
.
Early Bird Registration Discount:
Discounted early registration ends on
August 15, 2026
.
TAICEP Member Discount
The TAICEP Member price is available only to registered individuals with current membership. Members enjoy many benefits, including an immediate discount on conference registration and workshop fees. If you are unsure about your membership status, please inquire to
answers@taicep.org
. Conference registration fees do not include TAICEP membership dues.
NOTICE! ALERT! CONFERENCE SCHEDULE CHANGES! PLEASE READ!
Please take note of the following changes to this year's schedule to help with your travel planning:
Sunday Pre-Conference Excursion:
Join us for an optional excursion on
Sunday afternoon
.
Sunday Registration:
Pick up your badge between
1:00 PM and 6:00 PM
.
(You may also register Monday morning.)
3-Day Core Schedule:
The main conference sessions run full days,
Monday – Wednesday
.
No Pre-Conference Workshops:
Please note these have been removed for this year.
Conference Conclusion:
The final session ends
Wednesday at 6:00 PM
.
Post-Conference University Visit:
An optional visit is scheduled for
Thursday morning
.
Travel Tips
Arrival:
We recommend arriving by
Saturday evening or Sunday morning
if you wish to join the Sunday excursion. Otherwise, please arrive by Sunday afternoon for registration.
Departure:
If you plan to join the University Visit, we recommend departing
Thursday evening or Friday
. If you are not attending the visit, you may plan to depart
Thursday morning
.
Conference
Check-in
-
Begins Sunday, Oct 25 at 1 pm.
Your conference registration includes conference sessions, plenaries, meals (3 lunches, refreshment breaks), opening reception, and other activities throughout the conference unless otherwise noted.
Single-Day Conference Registration
Want to attend the TAICEP conference but have limited time or budget? A single-day registration ticket includes refreshment breaks, lunch on one day, sessions, and other activities for just one conference day. All single-day conference attendees are invited and encouraged to attend the reception on Monday evening.
Pre & Post Conference Events
The TAICEP Conference Committee has organized guided group events on Sunday afternoon before the conference and Thursday morning after the conference. We hope you'll join us.

Exhibitor Information:
The exhibitor table ticket does not include conference registration. All exhibitors must also purchase an individual conference registration. Visit the
Exhibitor Information
page for additional information.
Sponsor an Event:
TAICEP offers various events you can sponsor.
Please go to
Sponsor a Conference Event
for information on the available options
.
Sponsor a Colleague:
Did you enjoy your past TAICEP Conference experiences and want to pay it forward? Even the smallest donation can make a huge difference. For information on the available options, please go to
Sponsor a Colleague
.
Refunds:
Due to our space, food, and beverage commitments (costs), please carefully review the TAICEP Conference Cancellation Terms at the bottom of the conference
homepage
.
